description: Nightly build of PLASMA, the LSL sensor-acquisition platform
notes: This is a nightly build off `dev`, rebuilt automatically every day at
07:00 UTC; expect it to be less stable than `plasma`.
Installs the same `plasma` command and PLASMA Start Menu shortcut as
the `plasma` manifest; uninstall one before installing the other.
Config, gyro-bias calibration and recordings are written to
